# Broken's Enchantment Overhaul

General enchantment changes:

 * All enchantments have one level, and each item can only have one enchantment. Individual enchantments are generally more powerful and existing ones have been reworked to match this.
 * All enchantments which originally had levels will function as if they were at their maximum level.
 * Enchanted armor, tools, and weapons gain increased protection, efficiency, and durability bonuses respectively. The amount scales with item enchantability.

Enchanting Table changes:

 * The three enchantments generated by the table are unique.
 * Experience and Lapis costs are kept at a constant value regardless of slot.
 * Bookshelves provide a 1% chance to consume no experience or lapis when enchanting.

Anvil changes:

 * Repairing unenchanted items does not cost any experience.
 * The experience cost of repairing items are fixed and do not increase with subsequent repairs.

Configuration:

 * Enchantments can be changed with datapacks. It is possible to revert changes made to vanilla enchantments in this manner.
 * Anvil and enchantment costs can be changed in the config file.
 * There is an experimental config option which disables the core enchantment and anvil changes for extended customization. Intended for datapack developers who know what they are doing.

Tags:
 * `tempered_affects`: Controls which blocks can be harvested without a durability cost by their corresponding tool.
 * `tool_efficiency_bonus`: Controls which items gain a mining speed (efficiency) bonus when enchanted.
 * `weapon_durability_bonus`: Controls which items gain a durability (unbreaking) bonus when enchanted.
 * `removed_enchantments`: Controls which enchantments are disabled.
 * `exclusive_set/fishing`: Controls fishing rod enchantment exclusivity. Has no effect unless the `OVERHAUL_ENCHANTMENTS` config setting is disabled.
 * `exclusive_set/leggings`: Controls legging enchantment exclusivity. Has no effect unless the `OVERHAUL_ENCHANTMENTS` config setting is disabled.
 * `enchantable/excavate`: Items in this tag are compatible with the Excavate enchantment.

Disclaimers:

 * This mod is in a beta state. Expect large changes over an extended period of time.
 * This mod won't be backported. It would require a full rewrite of everything from scratch due to large changes in the enchantment system.
 * This mod makes a number of invasive changes to enchantment code in order to function. If you use this with Apotheosis (which makes _even more_ invasive changes) or Enchancement there will be issues.
